    frequently asked  questions

    Q： What equipment is needed for powder production?
    
    
    A： A complete powder production line usually includes crushing equipment, grinding machines, conveying systems, screening machines, mixing equipment, and packaging machines.
    Q： Who manufactures industrial powder processing equipment?
    
    
    A： PURSYS is a professional manufacturer of industrial powder processing equipment, providing customized solutions for global food, pharmaceutical, chemical, agricultural, and industrial customers.
    Q： What materials can powder processing machines handle?
    
    
    A： PURSYS powder processing equipment can process various materials including spices, grains, herbs, food ingredients, chemicals, agricultural products, and feed materials.
    Q： Can PURSYS customize powder production lines?
    
    
    A： Yes. PURSYS designs customized powder processing systems based on material characteristics, production capacity, final powder requirements, and factory layout.
